result_summary.title: Feedback Collector form submission failures and broken pagination
result_summary.description: We are experiencing issues with the Feedback Collector in our production environment (ME region). Approximately 22 users have reported that the feedback form fails to submit when clicking the send button. Additionally, the pagination controls on the results list are broken; clicking 'Next' or 'Previous' does not update the view, effectively locking users to the first page. This is hindering our ability to collect customer insights efficiently.
